claims.claim: B works in the same office as A
claims.attribute: B is employed in the same office as A

evidence.quote: Are you sure it was sent to the whole office ?
I'll have to talk to our secretary about it .
What time does our meeting start ?

claims.adjudication_reason: 'our meeting' (turn 1), 'our secretary' (turn 9), and 'sent to the whole office' (turn 7) all presuppose B works in the same office as A.

claims.claim: B shares a secretary with A
claims.attribute: B and A have a common secretary

evidence.quote: I'll have to talk to our secretary about it .

claims.adjudication_reason: 'our secretary' in turn 9 is a definite possessive presupposing B shares the secretary with A.

claims.claim: B referenced a memo about a meeting to A
claims.attribute: B brought up a memo concerning a meeting

evidence.quote: What memo ? There haven't been any memos this whole week .

claims.adjudication_reason: A's 'What memo?' (turn 5) and 'The meeting was proponed?' (turn 3) are direct responses presupposing B referenced a memo about a postponed meeting.

claims.claim: B is familiar with A's desk habits
claims.attribute: B knows how things pile up on A's desk when A is busy

evidence.quote: You know how things get piled up on my desk when I am busy

claims.adjudication_reason: 'You know how things get piled up on my desk' (turn 7) presupposes B is familiar with A's desk habits.

claims.claim: B told A that the meeting was postponed
claims.attribute: B informed A about a meeting postponement

evidence.quote: The meeting was proponed ? No one told me anything about it .

claims.adjudication_reason: A's surprised 'The meeting was proponed?' (turn 3) presupposes B just informed A about the postponement.

claims.claim: B claimed the memo was sent to the whole office
claims.attribute: B asserted the memo's distribution scope was the whole office

evidence.quote: Are you sure it was sent to the whole office ?

claims.adjudication_reason: Second-review support: A's question 'Are you sure it was sent to the whole office?' is a challenge directed at B's prior assertion. The interrogative form 'Are you sure X?' presupposes that X has been claimed by the addressee. A is not asking an open question about office-wide distribution; A is disputing B's stated certainty. This establishes that B claimed the memo was sent to the whole office.

claims.claim: B is not the secretary A would talk to about the memo
claims.attribute: B is a different person from A's secretary

evidence.quote: I'll have to talk to our secretary about it .

claims.adjudication_reason: A says 'I'll have to talk to our secretary about it' (turn 9) while addressing B, presupposing B is not the secretary A would consult.
